exposure: Foley catheter alone or combined with misoprostol and/or Oxytocin
cohort: 163 mothers with IUFD at or after 20 weeks gestation
finding: In a cohort of women with IUFD, cesarean section was associated with placental abruption, having two or more previous cesarean deliveries, and use of a Foley catheter for induction.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with placental abruption, having two or more previous cesarean deliveries, and use of a Foley catheter for induction.
